title: Seated figure, Geneva

units.note: Reconstruction units are scale-ambiguous. Set a reference length to measure.

mesh.note: Approximate surface from depth fusion. Unobserved sides remain open.

findings.message: 3 of 43 frames look blurry. Removing them will likely improve the reconstruction. The blur looks directional, which usually means the camera moved too fast.
43 frames look underexposed. Brighter, even lighting helps feature matching.
Large parts of the images are plain or featureless. Smooth walls and blank surfaces are hard to reconstruct.
34 frames are nearly identical to their neighbour. A smaller, more varied set is enough.

processing.depth: Depth Anything V2 Small, aligned to SfM + multi-view consistency (device: mps)
